name: Pendle
description: Pendle Finance is a protocol that enables the trading of tokenized future yield on an AMM system.

methodology.Fees: Total yield from deposited assets + trading fees paid by yield traders.
methodology.Revenue: Share of yields and trading fees collected by protocol
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of yields and trading fees collected by protocol
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Yields and trading fees diestibuted to depositors and liqudiity providers
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Share of yields and trading fees distributed to vePENDLE
